# Industri Nikkoplas Sdn. Bhd.

> ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 14001:2015 certified plastic injection moulding manufacturer in Johor Bahru, Malaysia (since 1988). One-stop service from injection moulding (50T–450T, 26 machines) to secondary processing and sub-assembly for electronics, telecom and engineering-grade plastic components. Resins: PS, ABS, PC.

Contact: bntee@nikkoplas.com | +607-237-0021
Address: 2B, Jalan Tampoi 2, Kawasan Perindustrian Tampoi, 81200 Johor Bahru, Johor, Malaysia
Languages: English (default), Traditional Chinese (/zh/), Japanese (/ja/), Korean (/ko/)
